content: Hold on to what is true, even when it is not generally accepted by most people, that something is not accepted by the majority doesn't mean that it is wrong. Follow hard after God's Word, the word is truth, it is the greatest strength and surety that anyone can have in life. Trust in the Lord, put your hope in His word, it is fail proof.

The Only limitation to your success is your belief, If you believe you can't, then you can't, if you believe you can, then you sure can. Now this is more than just to mentally ascent to something, but it is where the convictions of your heart are immovable from the reality that is yours in Christ Jesus. Be conscious of what you believe about yourself, a belief system can be changed, depending on the information that you feed on. Feed on the Word!

The Hope that the world needs is inside of you. In a world where everyone seems to be looking out for solutions and counsel; as the body of Christ we need to step up to the challenge and be their solution. God has done all that He would do for the World, He sent Jesus His only begotten Son, when Jesus died and reconciled all things to God He sent us as ministers of reconciliation.

Don't carry on with the negatives, the year is coming to a close a New Year offers new opportunities, don't allow the negatives to spill over, the word tells us to hold on to what is true; hold tight to the blessings of God, to His greatness in your life. Celebrate all the victories of the year, let them define your year. Be thankful for 2018, see all the wonders that the Lord has done and rejoice.

Make the divine way, your only way. In every situation in life there is the natural way of handling things and then there's God's way, the world will offer solutions according to man's wisdom and understanding, but the wisdom of God is higher it defies all human logic, and brings you into the class of all round possibilities; the God class here Faith is your key to unlock this power!

As the Year comes to a close, there is so much to be thankful for, the Lord has Faithfully seen you and I through 2018. In as much as you can today look back on 2018 holistically, you must realise that you lived it one day at a time, and so shall it be in 2019, From tomorrow you get a chance to define what the whole 2019 will be like. Make the day count, receive the daily allocation of the Grace of the Lord.

Happy New Year, 2019 is for you to influence all things around you, take time to do things more actively this year, don't let things happen make things happen. Be your best, give your best in all that you do, the great things of the year are not necessarily in the year but they are more accurately in You and me. You are light, so shine for all to see!

2019 is great and filled with New things but it's will not happen just because the Year is 2019, you have to take advantage of the Grace, you have to position and align yourself with the theme and direction of the Year to receive what the Lord is doing. The Favor, Blessing or Power of God is not necessarily on 2019, it's on you!! 2019 will not be a year of favor for example, If you don't experience favor in your life. Get ready to experience the manifest glory of God.

Faith requires action, the action of Faith is what gives life to the manifestation of God in our lives. Faith is the action taken by one in response to the Word. When Jesus told Peter to Come to Him on the water, Peter couldn't claim to have faith if he didn't take a step out of the boat onto the water, Faith there was expressed in him shifting his weight from the boat onto the water. Take your steps of Faith this year, walk out on the water in response to the Word of God!

Grace will take you further than your abilities and hard work can, God qualifies the called, and not vice versa. God's desire you to walk in Heavenly abilities that will allow you to function and influence the world past your human abilities. Let the Grace of God function in and through you today.

When you put your trust in God, it means you allow Him to be everything that you are and that you will ever need. Whatever the current circumstances of your life are you must put your trust in the Lord, trusting in the Lord is not just for the areas of weakness and need, but also in those areas where you profess strength and surety. Human security is fleeting, trust in the Lord you shall never be shaken.

Be grateful for the things that the Lord has done for you in the past, but don't live there, what God did was amazing yet there is a future for you even greater if you will trust Him. Just when you think you've seen God's best, He reminds us that we haven't seen anything yet. Embrace the newness of His Love and Grace , and walk out into a glorious future.

The first thing when it comes to being blessed by God is being called to be a blessing. The Lord blessing of the Lord is strong upon a conduit. It's not about how much you can accumulate, but rather it's about how much you can live out and build up others, how many people's lives will be changed because of you being blessed? You are blessed to be a blessing!

The Glory of God is not meant to only shine in Heaven, the Word of God declares to us the Glory of God fills the Earth as the waters cover the sea, the whole Earth shows forth His Glory, the trees, the skies, the light of the stars and all creation; yet God is not moved by that, He desires us to shine forth His glory in Truth the true nature of who He is. You are His Glory!

God doesn't desire servants and slaves to work FOR Him, He desires son's who will work WITH Him to bring about His will on the Earth. Jesus showed us how we are to live this life, and when He left He said as the Father sent Me so I send you, God did not send Jesus are a servant but He testified before them "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased", we are called to function as sons.

Jesus did not come to give us a religion, He came that we may have life abundantly. He is not just your ticket to Heaven, He is very much concerned about every faculty of your life. Jesus is your everything your daily life and your eternity. The benefit comes when we begin to see Him this way, allow Him into every area of our lives, let His light touch all parts of our life.

It is a shame to claim all that Jesus has done for us in His death burial and Resurrection, and live far short of it, refuse to live life as if Jesus didn't do all that was done for you. We must receive and respond to this life by faith, Confess it, meditate on it, let your words align with the reality of Work that has been done for you.

What do you have that you have not received from the Lord? He is the giver of all that we have; all the things that we enjoy and the things we take for Granted come from Him. In the same light for the things we seem not to have yet we can look to Him to supply, He is the giver and the provider. The Lord loves it when we come to Him in Faith and Trust.

From Genesis to Revelation the Eternal Father has put things in place for us to know Him and to walk in Victory. Many are seeking for the knowledge of God else where other than the Word, but God's primary source of revelation is the Word, Build your life on the revelation of the Word, and not fables and stories of men, to know the Father is to know Him through His Word.

Give your all to a cause that is bigger than yourself, it is selfish to live only for your own success and your family; have goals in life that are bigger than you and your inner circle. The Love of God in us compels us to live out for others, when you are building your strength let it be so that you are strong enough to lift others. You are blessed to be a blessing.

The hope of all mankind is Jesus Christ, He is the Light of the World, He is the illumination that everyone needs for the areas of Life that seem to be in darkness. You can entrust your life to the one who knows all your affairs and is very much concerned about you. Jesus Loves you more than you'll ever know and He has a perfect plan for you, walk in the Light of His Love for you.

Let your dreams see the Light of day, no dream was meant only to be lived in the dream realm, bring them out to the light, stop holding yourself in fear and doubt, give your dream wings to fly, and it will carry you to higher plane in life. God blesses us with dreams and ambitions to see the possibility of the future that is available to us, that dream is a seed let it grow and bring forth fruit.

Let's preach the gospel in and out of season, everyone needs to hear what the Lord has done for them. The power to save is in the preached Gospel, every time the Gospel is proclaimed, the power unto salvation is released! It cracks open the hardest of hearts, and brings the vilest of sinners to the revelation of the Perfect Savior.

Things don't just happen on their own, we have to make them happen, life will produce for you what you put into work; words and actions are seeds that make life happen, do your best therefore to use what you have for the Glory of God! Your life is for His Glory! Step out into the wonder of what the Lord has made available to you.

How badly do you want it? That thing that you dream about, is it merely a wish? Or do you believe that purpose there is nothing else for you but to fulfil that desire. This is usually the difference between those who succeed and those who barely go through life. To win in life you are going to have to want it so bad, if God placed that dream in you get on your face and give yourself to wholly unto it.

You are a winning machine, designed by God to win in all that you do. God has equipped you with all that you need to be successful; the Word, the baptism of the Holy Ghost, Prayer, His divine power etc. Don't ever give up on any project or assignment, you were born and designed to win, every test is only there for your promotion. You stay winning.

You can actually do it, yes you are just the right person to bring forth the plans and purposes of God! Nothing is impossible, those visions from God can be actualized. God has poured out abundant Grace for us to walk in and experience; this is life beyond what the mind can conceive. Function with the Grace made available to you by Christ Jesus, there is more than enough power at your disposal.

Jesus saved us and made us saviors, He helped us and made us Helpers, He lifted us and made us lifters. We are not just here to live life on the receiving end, we are here to be givers we are people on a mission sent to bless the world around us, live each day with a sense of purpose Jesus brought, think of your World is your mission field, accept the challenge to go.

Live life from the heights of Love, Love is the highest, it is the greatest, it is the perfection of all things. There is no law of man, nature or science that is against the law of Love. Love is an overwhelming force to which all hatred, corruption and conflict bows, it is the solution to all of humanities ailments. Live life from the heights of Love.

To know the will of God you must have a strong desire for it, the currency for walking into great encounters with the Lord is desire. Desire attracts what the heart is reaching towards; both good and evil. Those with a desire for God will seek hard after Him. Don't live a passionless life, embrace passion in you and let it fuel you towards all that you want out of life.

There are things which are only reserved for the diligent seeker, they are only available for the one who is on a passionate search, you will never find certain treasures in the surface, one has to dig deep into the earth to attain them. The deep and secret things of God come with a level of clearance based on one's tenacity to know and experience them. Press into the fullness of God today, refuse to live life on the surface... There is more!

The cross is an offense, because in it everyone sees what they deserve and no one can escape it. The cross demands a response, it makes no suggestions, it makes demands; are you going to accept or deny the sacrifice made for you and face consequences of either decision. Every human being faces this choice, We must keep preaching the truth for there is no other way.

Heaven is not for spectators, we are to participate in the manifesting the will of God on the Earth. Jesus saved us and made us kingdom dispensers, to bring out the life and glory of God everywhere that we go. The Jesus that your world is going to experience is the Jesus that lives and manifests through you.

What value can you place on a soul? Any item is as valuable as the price someone is willing to pay for it. If God who owns the cattle in a thousand hills and to whom all the silver and gold belong; did not choose to save us with the sacrifice of all the animals on Earth, nor did He give the most beautiful and precious gems for our Salvation. but He Gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believe in Him should not perish but have everlasting life. How valuable is a soul to you?

The Lord calls us to bring people to the reality of what He did for them at the cross, that is to let them know that they in Christ have been reconciled to God! To preach anything less is to fail to understand your call. No one is sent to condemn another from their wrong, anyone who does not believe is condemned already. We are to tell them that they have already been reconciled to God through the cross and now they must accept and walk therein.

Decree and declare great things over your life, don't let your voice be shut down by the words of others speak over your own life. Many people live their lives at Mercy of the words of others, and the enemy capitalizes on those words to bring about failure in their lives, but speak today, put the word of God in your mouth and let it set the course of your life.

The Grace of God is not a theoretical concept, it is real and experiential, there are results of Grace that are possible for the one who entrusts His or Her life to the revelation of God's Grace. Grace is the Power that breaks the cycles of sin and shame off ones life, it's not just a teaching which says they are not there, it is a revelation that removes and destroys all the effects of sin in one's life.

If the only reason you love is because you are command to then have missed the essence of Lord, God did not love us out of necessity, He loved us because it's His nature, He saw us in defeat and shame, and was compassionate towards you. We don't love by compulsion, we love because we have been loved, we are full of love.

Jesus is the answer, that is not just a cliche it is the reality of things, In Him dwells all the treasure of Wisdom and Knowledge, He is the response to all the questions of Creation, He is the solution to every problem. Trusting Him with your life is and expression of Wisdom to begin with. He is your reality, He is the Truth.

The Blessing of the Lord is on His Word and it is activated in the life of the Believer. The Word of God will work in your life as you apply Faith, it just doesn't work for everyone, the word is alive and powerful, but to experience it one must first believe, Faith opens you up to the power and glory of the Word! Expose your life to the power of the Word.

Grace gives you strength, it is not a pacifier of weakness, Grace is the Ability of God at work in a man, unearned but purchased by Jesus Christ. You are no longer unworthy, the Blood of Jesus makes you worthy, it makes you deserving of all the blessings of God! For they were purchased for you, This is the working of righteousness.

The Lord has given us His word to guide us, the Word of God is Light, you do not need to feel anything, all you need is to accept, and walk in its Light. The Word is alive and powerful, anyone who responds to it by believing and doing, will reap the divine benefits, thereof, this is walking in the Light.

Don't be too soon satisfied, the Lord has so much in store for you, there is more out there to be experienced and engaged. God has so much for us to walk in, as a believer you have access to Heaven and to the blessedness of the realms of God's glory. There is more for you to experience, don't stop here a higher calling awaits you.

Run towards the truth that you know, once truth has been revealed to you it demands a response, it is better never to have known something than to have known it but not responded to it. You are responsible for the truth that is revealed to you, you cannot sit and do nothing, we must be proper stewards of the revelation of God's truth. It shall change your life and the lives of those around you.

Are you willing to embrace the fullness of what God has called you unto? Can you give your life for a purpose that is bigger than yourself? There is a glorious future that the Lord has in store for you, but you must equally desire it, be willing to let go of what you have known and are comfortable with that you may gain a whole new glorious life in Christ!

Jesus is the true Light, though there are billions of world views, there is only One light of truth Jesus is the one who gives us the true meaning of life, He shines and illuminates everything in existence. The true colors are the colors that are seen in Christ. Hold up your life to the light of Christ, see who you are in Him, that is your true life.

Power is available to you, it is at your disposal, you just have to tap into it, you are not trying to work up enough power to accomplish anything, it's a matter of using what you have, and knowing how to release it. You received power when the Holy Spirit came upon you, you already have it, now what you need to learn is to release and function in it.

When searching for your way in life don't ever, look to man to give you directions; they may advise you but it will only be from the stand point of what one sees here and now, only the Lord who knows your future and why it will play out that way can lead you perfectly. Many have received His leading but second guess His voice because of the outside reality. Trust and obey and take the leap of faith.

Jesus gives life that nothing can compare to, you cannot accept Christ and live an ordinary life, receiving Christ is to accept and supernatural life filled with wonder and joy. Christianity is not merely about being kind hearted and benevolent, it is the pulsating life of Christ in a man.

When you come into Christ you automatically become an heir of God! You have an inheritance, there is a portion for you in life, a portion of Blessing, Strength, Success power etc... All that Christ owns belongs to you, you are a joint heir with Him, what is His is yours. Your inheritance is of God; square your shoulders, lift your head high and walk in all that is yours in Christ!
